HomePage.title: Manava Bandhutva Vedike
HomePage.subtitle: Free occupational training for youth across Karnataka.
HomePage.statsSubtitle: Real numbers from across the platform.
HomePage.howSubtitle: From your first visit to a job — four simple steps.
HomePage.step1Body: Explore upcoming training programs and activities, and apply to register your interest.
HomePage.step2Body: Submit a short application. Our team reviews it and confirms your place.
HomePage.step3Body: Attend hands-on sessions at a center near you, guided by experienced trainers.
HomePage.step4Body: Earn a verified certificate and connect with employers hiring for your skills.
HomePage.aboutBody: Manava Bandhutva Vedike (MBV) is a non-profit dedicated to empowering youth across Karnataka through free, high-quality occupational training. We partner with employers and communities to turn skills into livelihoods — at no cost to the trainee.
HomePage.aboutPoint3: Direct pathways to placement and employment
HomePage.ctaSubtitle: Applications are open. Take the first step toward a new career today.
HomePage.branchesSubtitle: Find an MBV branch near you.
HomePage.futureSubtitle: Upcoming training programs and activities at MBV.
HomePage.futureNote: New programs are announced regularly. Apply now to register your interest, and we'll reach out when a suitable program opens near you.
HomePage.futureEmpty: No upcoming programs are listed right now — but you can still apply below and we'll contact you.
HomePage.branchNoCenters: Training center details for this district are coming soon.
HomePage.branchNoUpdates: No updates have been posted for this district yet.
HomePage.objectivesSubtitle: What we set out to achieve.
HomePage.objective1: Provide free, job-ready vocational training to underserved youth.
HomePage.objective2: Expand access to skilling across every district of Karnataka.
HomePage.objective3: Build direct bridges between trainees and employers.
HomePage.objective4: Follow up on outcomes to ensure lasting livelihoods.
HomePage.contactSubtitle: Have a question? We'd love to hear from you.
HomePage.activitiesSubtitle: Recent activity photos and updates from across MBV.
HomePage.activitiesEmpty: No activity reports yet. Branch admins can post photos with a description.
